title: The scalar second-projection unit/Chern splitting isomorphism
statement: In the setting of [lem-sfb-rational-p1-scalar-chern-splittings], the explicit second-projection twisted unit and transported Chern adjunct form an isomorphism: the corresponding biproduct.desc map is invertible. This is one conjunct of the two-splitting statement and contains no exchange or trace equation.

proof.text: Positive twisting and shifting of the model unit/Chern splitting gives the corresponding scalar biproduct map; restriction, completion, realization and the prescribed scalar mates transport its invertibility to the explicit coefficient map.
